That snapshot does not cancel the physical dependence on ice or projections of increased fasting and reduced cub survival as ice-free seasons lengthen, especially in southern parts of the range. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution are additional pressures, but they do not make sea-ice loss irrelevant. There is no scientific basis for the claim that polar bears are thriving because of chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because one subpopulation increased.
